name: 饱和度分布
description: Analyzes the distribution of color saturation values. AI images often have different saturation profiles than natural photographs.
mechanism: Computes saturation for each pixel and analyzes the resulting distribution. AI images may show peaks at unusual saturation values.
parameters: Color space: HSV, Metric: saturation histogram statistics
useCase: Detecting unusual saturation profiles in AI-generated images

references.title: Farid, H. (2009). Image Forgery Detection. IEEE Signal Processing Magazine.
Van de Weijer, J. et al. (2007). Edge-based Color Descriptors. IEEE TIP.
Lukáš, J. et al. (2006). Digital Camera Identification from Sensor Pattern Noise. IEEE TIFS.

strengths:
• Reveals unnatural color saturation patterns
• Camera sensors have characteristic saturation curves
• AI images often show atypical saturation distributions
• Fast histogram-based computation
• Complementary chrominance analysis
limitations:
• Post-processing (vibrance, saturation) changes distribution
• Depends heavily on scene content and lighting
• Monochrome or low-saturation images are uninformative
• Camera white balance affects saturation patterns
• AI models improving at realistic saturation
